text:
Sam (AM): Heads up 0: HelioCorp wants to move forward with renewal but insists on paying by a third-party procurement card. They need access to services ASAP.
Nina (CS): third-party card = vendor card? do we have precedents?
Sam (AM): its their procurement vendor (card on file belongs to procurement@heliocorp). Contracted signer is still their GC though.
Diego (RevOps): risky but doable. Recommend: conditional acceptance with signed payer authorization, billing contact attestation, and a 48h hold for dispute checks.
Priya (Legal): must have an amendment specifying alternate payer and explicit authorization. Also include language about chargeback liability and verification steps. Can draft quick.
Olga (Finance): we can process a card charge if we receive: (1) signed payer authorization, (2) proof of relationship (procurement agreement or vendor letter), (3) billing email match or confirmation call. Otherwise require PO.
Sam (AM): customer timeline: wants us to provision tomorrow morning. They can return docs today.
Nina (CS): ill send a short checklist to them and offer the standard 7-day PO grace if they can't get the vendor docs in time.
Diego (RevOps): two options for HelioCorp: expedited card path (card charge after docs + manual review) OR PO path (standard process + 10-day onboarding delay). Which to present?
Priya (Legal): include a clause: "Alternate payer acknowledges authority to charge and agrees to indemnify Redwood for any unauthorized chargebacks." Short and clear.
Olga (Finance): route any card attempts to queue "cc_manual_review". Well run the verification scripts and a small authorization hold before final capture.
billing-bot: Invoice preview generated: invoice_2026-0921 preview (amount: $120,500)  https://billing.redwood/invoice/preview/2026-0921
Nina (CS): sent amendment + payer auth template to procurement@heliocorp. they replied theyll sign within 2 hours.
Sam (AM): @Priya please paste draft when ready. we need to close today.
Priya (Legal): Draft pasted: "Amendment: HelioCorp authorizes Procurement Vendor (name/email) to pay on its behalf. Procurement Vendor confirms authority. Procurement Vendor accepts chargeback responsibility and consents to verification checks"
Diego (RevOps): add: "Payment subject to 48-hour manual verification and a provisional hold until cleared."
Priya (Legal): done. final draft attached.
Olga (Finance): once we get signed docs, set up temp payment method and apply a $1 auth hold. If verification passes, capture full amount.
billing-bot: Temporary payment method created: temp_card_heliocorp by Diego. Manual hold applied.
Nina (CS): Procurement returned signed forms and a vendor letter. sending files to billing.
Olga (Finance): running verification now. will confirm within 3 hours.
Sam (AM): great. if anything flags, switch to PO path and offer a 5% onboarding credit for the delay.
Nina (CS): putting renewal risk = "elevated" in Gainsight until payment is captured. will update onboarding schedule post-clearance.
Olga (Finance): Verification complete. small mismatch on billing email resolved after a call. Card cleared. Marking invoice_2026-0921 as PAID.
billing-bot: Invoice invoice_2026-0921 status updated -> PAID (txn id tx_z4y3x2).
Sam (AM): closing loop with HelioCorp now. moving to closed-won. thanks all.
Priya (Legal): reminder: save signed amendment to contract repo and cc legal@redwood.
Nina (CS): saved PDF to contract-folder/heliocorp/ and updated customer record. :tada:
